description: Housing for people with intellectual and developmental disabilities is about to see another boost in state funding. Lawmakers this year set aside $19 million for it in the Housing Trust Fund. That brings this two-year budget cycle’s total to almost $44 million, a tenfold increase from most other budgets. “This is a big deal,” Rep.
